INTERNAL CONTROL QUESTIONNAIRE
Client: Harbour & Pine Joinery Ltd    Year ended 30 June 2026

Section A: Sales and receivables
A1. Are orders approved before goods are made? Yes, by the production manager against the customer's credit limit.
A2. Are invoices numbered in sequence and gaps reviewed? Yes, monthly by the accountant.
A3. Are credit notes authorised? By the finance director only.
--- page ---
Section B: Purchases and payables
B1. Are purchase orders raised for all purchases over $1,000? Yes.
B2. Are goods received checked against the order? Yes, by the warehouse supervisor, who signs the delivery note.
B3. Are supplier invoices matched to orders and delivery notes before payment? Yes.
B4. How are changes to supplier bank details verified? Since April 2026 by a call-back to a number already on
file, recorded on the change form. Before that, by email.
--- page ---
Section C: Cash and payments
C1. Who can set up payments in online banking? The accountant.
C2. Who approves them? A director; two directors for payments over $10,000.
C3. Are bank reconciliations prepared monthly and reviewed? Yes, reviewed by the finance director.
C4. Is petty cash counted? Monthly; the float is $300.
--- page ---
Section D: Payroll and fixed assets
D1. Are new starters and leavers authorised in writing? Yes, by a director.
D2. Is a fixed asset register kept and assets checked against it? Yes, a count each June. The June 2026 count
found two items missing, a laptop and a tablet, reported as stolen (see the fraud-risk questionnaire).
D3. Are disposals authorised? By the finance director.
